Select: chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, compound_structures, docs. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno; compound_records to docs on doc_id; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123859'; canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Sort: chembl_id ASC, compound_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC.
